svg.title: XNET Harness HALO and Oroboros architecture map
svg.desc: A status-aware architecture map. It shows verified source intake, RAG and HCE, a caller-owned model center surrounded by per-engine HALO advice and Oroboros context rotation, raw versus retrieval versus full XNET repair comparison, OpenClaw and NullClaw trust gates, optional storage and phone rings, a tested local transport-free Legions protocol core, and planned Legions networking, execution, scheduling, quorum, and aggregation layers.

g.text: XNET~ Harness • HALO / Oroboros system map
A model-neutral evidence harness around caller-owned inference • status and trust boundaries are part of the design
*Included behavior on synthetic fixtures; no deployment, model-quality, or speed claim.
Selected bytes become bounded, source-addressed context.
Commands stay data; the upstream app is not invoked.
Cancel • contain • quarantine | admit ledger + CAS
Receipts, immutable indexes, CAS, and verified fetch.
The application owns the model, prompt rendering, token count, session, credentials, and tools.
Exact measured prompt in; review/headroom advice out. HALO does not rotate a session.
review due → caller creates fresh session → verified replay
No global token threshold • no hidden-state transfer • no silent provider fallback
Labels describe possible deployment tiers, never automatic discovery or authority.
Four logical-root circulation + local readback are tested.
*Illustrative deployment names. Sync, capacity, and remote provider readback stay caller-managed.
Source UI + pure gates exist; live TLS and device compute are not certified.
†Only after hardware, thermal, policy, model, and per-device HALO qualification.
Implemented benchmark infrastructure; the diagram does not report or imply a score.
No retrieved card or XNET route
Same two cards across bounded attempts
Retrieval + HCE IDs + route + accordion retry
Context expands only after a public failure
Same model • same strict schema • same bounded evaluator • at most one public-feedback retry • hidden feedback withheld
one bounded retry when policy permits
Retain the incumbent after a tie or regression; promote guidance only under declared outcome and cost rules.
Harness policy may change. Model weights do not change in this loop. Successful receipts do not establish unseen generalization.
Networking, execution, and coordination remain planned.
Capability card • job capsule • WorkerGate admission
kill / revoke / replay • HMAC-SHA256 result receipt
Hash-addressed; caller supplies peer identity, key, clock, and sandbox.
Planned; no combined-result or throughput claim.
PRIVACY BOUNDARY • only explicitly scoped input bytes may cross
1 → N means separately admitted jobs, never automatic authority.
Measure end to end; no linear-speed, quality, or private-data claim.
